content: Ulnǝ ɗǝ Bezǝ' yakǝn Mbalǝn u
Nǝ palisiyawa nǝ gyen mi' bǝtl lashti zhil ki Musa ginǝ mbǝ te' Ulshelima is domga ma' Yesu.
Is yeni na mil kushti wasi si ɗamti siɗa o'kǝl towai tǝngaki bǝtl lǝɓa ki mi' kina.
Palisiyawa ne' Yehudawa sǝn ɗa ɗamti pawai senǝ sa o'kǝl toh pa, gaki si bǝtl lǝɓa ki mi' kina.

In sa pal te'ge'lu dobga ki ulti nǝ ulti taka u, sǝnɗa ɗamtipawai senǝ sa utisi mal takapa. Undǝ laɓa enɗa diɓǝli nǝsmbima' mi'kina wasǝn asi pǝlti, kǝnǝ ki o'kǝl gali ne' ki twom mali ne' kal ki dom.
I palisiyawa ne' mi' kulci' mbalǝn zhil ki Musa is ngemti, “Ya lakiɗa mil kushti wagi siɗa bǝtl ulnǝs mbima mi'kina wasǝn u wai, si ɗamti bǝsiɗa o'kǝtl towai?”
I' ulsisu, “Bali Ishaya dlǝmi tǝnkini, mi' bǝna ki dwaɗǝn, kan u nǝ ɗa ki laci u:

content.text: Bǝtl Lya wasǝn u bali wai,
ge'shu ki zhil ki Lya, zhil ki mbalǝn kǝn si kulcissi.’

content: Ka lakǝn zhil ki Lya taka i, ka ngapǝn zhil ki mi' kina i.”
I' ulsisu, “Kimanǝn shitu ki la'ti zhil ki Lya taka huti aki ngapti zhil ki mi' kina.
Gaki Musa usu, ‘Nal bwagi nǝ dyawagi,’ ‘Mulnǝ, abyal bwasu ko dyawasu, a tloti.’
Ngo nǝnǝgu kini ki usu, in mulnǝ azi ulǝn tǝngaki ti' ɗǝl bwasi nǝ dyawasi adǝm Kolban i', (iki, abǝl Lya i)
nǝgu katl, kǝkǝn za'titi tǝ'pǝli bwasi ko dyawasi kyautǝn ki ulǝnwai.
Nǝgu lakiɗa ki ɗa katshilǝn ki Lya baliwai gaki bǝtl zhil ki mi' kina. Ki njikǝ' pǝtl undigi.”
Ɗaɗanu i Yesu taki diɓǝl mbalǝn bi, i' ulsisu, “Kumǝnnǝni muswakǝn, a'manangu.
Ulnǝ ɗǝ su' ge' yakǝn mbalǝn tu'dla u i ɗǝ bezǝtiwai, ulnǝ ɗǝ pe'tito' ge'tu ɗǝ bezǝti.”
Mul kǝm ki kumti, ti' kumi,
Kalki za'ti hwu'mbalǝn i, nǝtte libi u, i mil kushti wasi is ngemti yakǝn cimbǝlti u ɗǝ dlǝmti.
I' ulsisu, “Kinima kimaniniwaiya?” “Ulnǝ ɗǝ suge' mbalǝn tu'dla u, kǝn bezǝtiwai,
Nǝbǝ ambadlwas kǝn suwai u, atu'ɗa'ka su, tu'nǝgu tǝpekki.” Nǝnǝgu Yesu pal mus ulki ɗami ki zeki.
I' usu, “Ulnǝ ɗǝpe'ti to'ge' tu'ki yakǝn mbalǝn u iɗǝ bezǝt'ti.
A tugi, age' mbadl ki yakǝn mbalǝn, kǝn bezǝn lǝɓa ɗǝpe'ti, kǝnǝ kwonti, nǝ mǝgǝlti, nǝ tlom mbalǝn,
nǝ pǝti, nǝ lyap lǝɓa, nǝ ngashti, nǝ ship totugi, nǝ nge Lya, nǝ ndau bishitu, nǝ bezǝn dǝmti, nǝ nalkiga, nǝ kon nǝmbalǝn, nǝ ndokǝnti.
Mus bezǝn lǝɓagi atu'kǝn sipe'titoɗi, si ɗǝ bezǝn mbalǝn.”
Lati mbatl ki Kǝli Solopinikiya
I Yesu za'lǝbi illǝ Taya nǝ Sidon. It tege' libiwon, ta lyami tǝmulǝn maniwai ngo' nǝnǝgu a hwunwai.
Kǝliwon, gunǝ du mi'gatli gob yakuwasi, nǝkumi Yesu ɗa ki u, illǝ in ndakina ɗakka.
Kǝliyisi yakǝn Helinawa ni, atlki zǝtti iki Solopinikiya ni. In ngem Yesu tǝp pekkǝli yakuwasi du mi'gatl taka.
I Yesu ultisu, “Hwe tǝkǝm mil pa, gaki a'mbuni akan ulki ɗami ki milwai tǝbǝl kaɗiwai.”
I kǝliyi ndǝgiti i'ultisu, “Mul nalti, ey nǝguɗa, ngo'nǝnǝgu kaɗi nǝnɗǝ ɗab bi ki mil.”
I Yesu ultisu, “Gaki shilǝnwa'gu, paltya, du mi'gatli aza' yakuwagi yakǝnkǝli.”
Nǝ' paltya libi u ille'mbi yakuwasi kǝmuɗi tǝn lumutti, du mi'gatli apeki.
Yesu ndokǝl mul nǝ bǝɗa kup kǝm nǝ ma'shilǝnwai u
I Yesu za' lukǝ Taya, i' bǝli Sidon tǝn shitu i' bǝli Dikapolis illǝ dlilka ki Galili.
Is mbǝlli' mulnǝ bǝɗa kub kǝmwai u mul ɗǝɗɗǝtibi, is ngemti tǝszitto.
I Yesu Kanti ispal malgǝni' ki hwu' mbalǝn, i Yesu shim mil toh age' kǝm ki mulisi, ibbeza makkǝn, ittǝn lǝgawasi.
Illa'ga lya immbǝ mbadli, i'ultisu, “Ippata!” (Iki, “ɓuli!”)
I kǝmwas ɓuli, i lǝgawas laki, i'gob shilǝn.
I Yesu dlimisi bǝs dlimi mulǝnwai. Sine se mbǝtl dlǝmtitǝnki siɗa.
Is kumgagashinti, is usu, “Tapǝl mus lǝɓa mbuni! Mulnǝ bǝ ɗa kubkǝmwai u ma ta kumi i, mul ɗǝɗɗǝti bima taman shilǝn I.”
